title: Hyperuniform random measures, transport and rigidity
abstract: This survey explores the foundational theory and recent developments in the study of hyperuniformity. We present a comprehensive mathematical framework in the context of weakly stationary random measures, emphasizing spectral characterizations and second order asymptotics. Classical examples - including determinantal point processes, Gibbs measures, and zero sets of Gaussian analytic functions - are presented in depth to illustrate core principles. We also highlight recent progress connecting hyperuniformity with optimal transport and rigidity phenomena, pointing to emerging directions in the field.
